% Data: figures/data/agreement.csv and presence.csv, generated by scripts/make_figures.py from
% research/pipeline-comparison-20261014.json and research/final-semantic-evidence-20261014.json.
\definecolor{pvblue}{RGB}{0,114,178}
\definecolor{pvorange}{RGB}{213,94,0}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{groupplot}[
  group style={group size=2 by 1, horizontal sep=1.5cm},
  width=.45\textwidth, height=3.7cm,
  symbolic x coords={efficient,balanced,quality}, xtick=data, enlarge x limits=0.22,
  ymajorgrids, ymin=0, tick label style={font=\small}, label style={font=\small},
  legend style={font=\small, at={(0.5,1.04)}, anchor=south, legend columns=2, draw=none, /tikz/every even column/.append style={column sep=4pt}},
]
\nextgroupplot[ybar, bar width=5.5pt, ylabel={Agreeing cases of 1,560}, ymax=1560]
\addplot[fill=pvblue!25, draw=pvblue] table[x=tier, y=joint_hist, col sep=comma]{figures/data/agreement.csv};
\addplot[fill=pvblue, draw=pvblue] table[x=tier, y=joint_upd, col sep=comma]{figures/data/agreement.csv};
\addplot[fill=pvorange!25, draw=pvorange] table[x=tier, y=action_hist, col sep=comma]{figures/data/agreement.csv};
\addplot[fill=pvorange, draw=pvorange] table[x=tier, y=action_upd, col sep=comma]{figures/data/agreement.csv};
\legend{Labels+action, Labels+action (updated), Allowed action, Allowed action (updated)}
\nextgroupplot[ybar, bar width=5.5pt, ylabel={Percent of rows}, ymax=100]
\addplot[fill=pvblue!25, draw=pvblue] table[x=tier, y=recall_hist, col sep=comma]{figures/data/presence.csv};
\addplot[fill=pvblue, draw=pvblue] table[x=tier, y=recall_upd, col sep=comma]{figures/data/presence.csv};
\addplot[fill=pvorange!25, draw=pvorange] table[x=tier, y=spec_hist, col sep=comma]{figures/data/presence.csv};
\addplot[fill=pvorange, draw=pvorange] table[x=tier, y=spec_upd, col sep=comma]{figures/data/presence.csv};
\legend{Recall, Recall (updated), Specificity, Specificity (updated)}
\end{groupplot}
\end{tikzpicture}
